-- Fix Kirsten: update Bright Apply sponsor to point to Kirsten's user account
UPDATE sponsors SET userId = 10650036 WHERE id = 390001;

-- Audit: show all sponsors with their linked user email vs contactEmail
SELECT 
  s.id,
  s.companyName,
  s.userId,
  u.email as linkedUserEmail,
  s.contactEmail,
  SUBSTRING_INDEX(u.email, '@', -1) as linkedDomain,
  SUBSTRING_INDEX(s.contactEmail, '@', -1) as contactDomain
FROM sponsors s
LEFT JOIN users u ON s.userId = u.id
ORDER BY s.companyName;
